skills.description: External long-term memory and knowledge base backed by the MemOS Cloud API. Capabilities — search prior memory, add conversation messages, delete or correct memories via feedback, retrieve a consolidated user profile (facts, preferences, tool history), and manage knowledge bases and their documents. Use proactively on every user turn (search memory before answering and persist the exchange after), and whenever the user references past context, their identity, preferences, or history, or asks to remember, recall, modify, forget, or correct something (e.g., "who am I", "what do I like", "remember that...", "forget X", "you got it wrong"). Also use when uploading, listing, or deleting knowledge base files.
